metaTitle: How to Choose a Screen House
description: Size, mesh, frame, roof and anchoring tips for choosing a screen house or screened canopy, plus how it differs from a pop-up canopy.
directAnswer: Pick a screen house by group size and site: 10 by 10 feet for four to six people, 12 by 12 for larger groups. Look for fine mesh, a sturdy frame, a roof that sheds rain and proper stakes, since they are wind sensitive.
